;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)|Second Libyan Civil War]], [[2019 Western Libya offensive]]
**[[Aguila Saleh]], speaker of the [[Tobruk]]-based [[House of Representatives (Libya)|Libyan parliament]] which [[Khalifa Haftar]]'s [[Libyan National Army]] is loyal to, states that no peace agreement or UN-backed conference is possible while [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]] "is occupied by armed groups". [https://www.foxnews.com/world/libya-speaker-no-deals-while-armed-groups-kidnap-tripoli (Fox News)]
**The Libyan National Army says it has shot down a pro-[[Government of National Accord|GNA]] [[Aero L-39 Albatros|L-39 Albatros]] over [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]]. [https://www.rt.com/news/456161-libya-plane-shot-down/ (RT)]

;International relations
*[[Brexit negotiations]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] and [[European Union]] agree to delay [[Brexit]] until October 31, 2019. This means that the UK will participate in next month's [[2019 European Parliament election|European Parliament election]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-47889404 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
* The United States federal government charges 24 in a [[Medicare (United States)|Medicare]] [[Medicare fraud|fraud]] scheme involving the billing of Medicare for nearly $1.2 billion in unnecessary [[back brace]]s and other medical braces pitched via [[telemarketing]] through [[durable medical equipment]] companies. [https://www.npr.org/2019/04/10/711688988/feds-charge-24-in-alleged-1-2-billion-medicare-fraud-scheme (NPR)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
** After the [[Organization of American States]] accepts an envoy from the government of President of the [[National Assembly (Venezuela)|Venezuelan National Assembly]] [[Juan Guaidó]] as ambassador, [[Vice President of the United States|United States Vice President]] [[Mike Pence]] asks for the [[United Nations]] to expel and replace the [[Nicolás Maduro]]-appointed Venezuelan envoy in its own chamber. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-04-10/pence-demands-un-expel-venezuela-s-ambassador-support-guaido (Bloomberg)]
** The [[International Monetary Fund]] denies Venezuela access to its money as there is no majority of member states recognizing either Maduro or Guaidó, describing the situation as "political chaos" and asking for debate between its members on the nation. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-04-10/imf-freezes-venezuela-funds-as-members-debate-who-s-president (Bloomberg)]

;Science and technology
* [[Katie Bouman]] and scientists at the [[Event Horizon Telescope]] project release the first ever photograph of the event horizon of a [[black hole]], that of the supermassive black hole at the center of [[Messier 87]] galaxy, taken using a network of eight radio telescopes around the world. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/04/10/world/black-hole-photo-scn/index.html (CNN)]
* ''[[Callao Man|Homo luzonensis]]'' is identified as a new species of [[Homo|human beings]] discovered in the [[Callao Cave]], [[Luzon|Northern Philippines]]. [https://www.nationalgeographic.com/science/2019/04/new-species-ancient-human-discovered-luzon-philippines-homo-luzonensis/ (''National Geographic'')]
